onboarding.title: Welcome to QuéComo
onboarding.subtitle: A household is the space you share with your partner, family or flatmates. You can have several.
onboarding.joinHint: Paste the invitation link you were sent.
onboarding.joinInvalid: That link doesn't look like a QuéComo invitation.

detail.inviteBody: Share this link with the person you want to invite. It works once and expires on {{date}}.
detail.revokeConfirm: Revoke this invitation? The link will stop working.
detail.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from this household? They will no longer see its recipes, menus and lists.
detail.removed: {{name}} is no longer part of the household
detail.transferConfirm: Transfer ownership to {{name}}? You'll become a member and can't undo this yourself.
detail.leaveConfirm: Leave “{{household}}”? You'll lose access to its data and will need a new invitation to come back.
detail.lastOwnerHint: You're the only owner: transfer ownership before leaving, or delete the household.
detail.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{household}}” and all its data for everyone? This can't be undone.
detail.deleteTypeName: Type the household name to confirm
